name: InitPlayerLinkedCollider
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x16: runs func_001921A8, allocates two 0x40-byte tables at 0x63C and 0x640, sets 0x644 to 1 and the four bound floats -1.5, 1.5, -0.7, 0.7

name: AddPlayerLinkedColliderId
evidence: appends a value to the table at 0x640 while the count at 0x638 is below 0x11

name: StartPlayerLinkedCollider
evidence: slot 20 of class 0x16: runs StartPlacedObject, finds the class 7 object (the player) with func_0015A448 and stores it at 0x620, 0x624 and 0x598, finds the objects at ids 0x160..0x163, and resolves the ids of the table at 0x640 into 0x63C

name: UpdatePlayerLinkedCollider
evidence: slot 21 of class 0x16: runs UpdateSwitchedCollider, then asks the player object's slot 81 and either changes the state of the other objects of class 5 gathered (ChangeAgentState with 0xA) or sets the flag at 0x580

name: ControlPlayerLinkedCollider
evidence: slot 73 of class 0x16 (the slot func_00173888 fills for the player): runs func_001E5938, on pad bits 0xC0 clears them and runs AdvancePlayerLinkedColliderWalker, then calls the player's own slot 73 with a cleared 0xC4-byte record while the object at +0x2740 of the player is attached

name: HandlePlayerLinkedColliderActivation
evidence: table offset 0x130 of class 0x16 (HandleSwitchedColliderActivation's slot): for a non-null argument sets the camera's value at 0x480 to 100.0 and copies the collider's matrix into it, otherwise sets 10.0 and undoes the screen element and device state

name: IsPlayerLinkedColliderCandidate
evidence: the filter func_001E5938 applies: refuses an object with bit 43 of +0x538, one whose +0x50 is the collider itself, one func_001A8820 finds in the pool at +0x618, or one either side's slot 60 rejects

name: ChoosePlayerLinkedColliderTarget
evidence: original assembly: inside a back-memory mark gathers the objects around the collider (GatherCollidersInBox), keeps those IsPlayerLinkedColliderCandidate accepts, measures them on screen (func_00144128, GetTextPanelCenter, ArctangentOfRatio) and picks the nearest (FindNearestSpanObject), marking it at +0x320; ControlPlayerLinkedCollider calls it

name: AdvancePlayerLinkedColliderWalker
evidence: when the state walker at +0x614 is at and heads for state 0x359 and the pool at +0x618 has a choice (HasObjectPoolChoice), sets the walker's target to 0x35A

name: HandlePlayerLinkedColliderNotification
evidence: slot 13 of class 0x16: runs the base handler func_00192230, then for kind 0x13 matches the source id against the device at 0x614 or the player object and sets 0x628 to 0 or 1 or calls func_001A8C90

name: TestPlayerLinkedColliderMayContact
evidence: slot 56 of class 0x16 (the slot TestAgentMayContact fills in class 8): TestCollidersMayContact, or the test func_001A8820 on the object at 0x618

name: StartPlayerLinkedColliderEffect
evidence: slot 78 of class 0x16: forwards the call to slot 78 of its linked object at +0x624 when it has one, else runs StartSwitchedColliderEffect

name: GetPlayerLinkedColliderInteractFlags
evidence: slot 0x154 of class 0x16, the slot GetPlayerInteractFlags fills for the player: clears both output flags

name: GetPlayerLinkedColliderTarget
evidence: returns the object at 0x620 when set, else itself

name: InitArcPoints
evidence: sets the element's size to 160 by 125.4, builds its 57 points on a half circle (x = +-sqrt(1-y*y), y from -1 to 1) with colours and random rates, and the three random pulse values; kind 0x1A mirrors it and uses other ranges

name: CreateArcSprite
evidence: slot 1: creates a type 0x51 record with CreateTypedRecord, sets its fields from D_00275650..D_00275660 and D_00275B58 and calls its slot 7

name: GetArcVisibleRange
evidence: writes the range of point indices (57 - n) / 2 .. (57 - n) / 2 + n centred in the 57 points, n being size * 57

name: WriteArcOutlineVertices
evidence: writes the outline vertices: a rectangle at the element's shown position when D_00270458 is 4, else the vertices of the visible points (GetArcVisibleRange) scaled by 62.7

name: WriteArcPointVertices
evidence: original assembly: writes the GIF entries (BeginGifTag, AddGifRgbaEntry, AddGifXyzfEntry) of the arc's visible points (GetArcVisibleRange) with random offsets (RandomFloatInRange); DrawArc calls it before WriteArcTickVertices

name: WriteArcTickVertices
evidence: picks the fade factor from the fade mode and time (5 per second, clamped 0..1), blends two colours with it and writes the tick-line vertices of the visible points, each from radius 62.7 to 62.7 + line length

name: DrawArc
evidence: slot 9: when func_001E9A68 allows it, writes the packet header and then the arc's outline and tick vertices

name: SetArcFade
evidence: stores the fade mode and the time D_00261868 when the mode changes

name: ApplyArcTarget
evidence: makes the target object the current one: calls slot 3 of the old and slot 2 of the new, links it to the element and sets bit 32 of its flags

name: SetArcPhase
evidence: switches the phase 0 (random level and rates for the 57 points, sound 0x8C), 1 (size 1), 2 (sound 0x8D) or 3 (size 0, ApplyArcTarget) and stamps the time

name: SetArcMode
evidence: slot 16: runs SetScreenElementMode, then on leaving mode 0 moves the element (to 640 by 360 when D_00270458 is 4, else to 160 by 125.4), and on mode 2 enters phase 3

name: UpdateArc
evidence: slot 2: runs UpdateScreenElementSlide, then grows or shrinks size by 5 per second and advances the phase, re-rolls pulse and level rates of the 57 points toward their targets, then calls slot 16 and SetArcPhase

name: QueueArcDraw
evidence: original assembly: slot 10 of the arc's screen element table D_0021A3F0: unless an arc menu is open (AreArcMenusClosed), builds the arc's frame in the world (BuildBasisFromXAndZHint, BuildMatrixFromRotationAndTranslation) and queues DrawArcOutlinePacket and DrawArcTickPacket (QueueDeferredRequest)

name: DrawArcOutlinePacket
evidence: the request QueueArcDraw queues: inside a back-memory mark builds a GIF packet of the arc's outline (WriteArcOutlineVertices, AddGifRgbaEntry, AddGifXyzfEntry) in a temporary buffer and sends it through VIF direct (WriteVifFlushE, WriteVifDirectFromWriter)

name: DrawArcTickPacket
evidence: the second request QueueArcDraw queues: inside a back-memory mark builds a GIF packet of the arc's visible points (GetArcVisibleRange, AddGifXyzfEntry, AddGifRgbaEntry) and sends it through VIF direct (WriteVifFlushE, WriteVifDirectFromWriter)

name: SetArcTarget
evidence: stores the target object; in state 4 of D_002701F8 switches modes and phases (1 and 2 when set, 3 and 0 when cleared), otherwise enters phase 2

name: SetArcSpecialObject
evidence: clears bit 32 of the old special object's flags, stores the new one and sets bit 32 on it

name: ResetArc
evidence: slot 5: runs ResetScreenElement and zeroes size, current and target and sets the phase to 3

name: ConstructGreyColor
evidence: the file's static initialiser: on the construction pass (1, 0xFFFF) sets the first four bytes of D_00275B50 to 0x80

name: ConstructGreyColorAtStartup
evidence: the file's _GLOBAL_$I$: calls ConstructGreyColor with (1, 0xFFFF); an entry of the startup init-list D_0027B130
